name: vwap_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, every institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithm benchmarks against the session VWAP; when NIFTY tests VWAP 3+ times, each test partially exhausts the opposing resting limit orders defending that level. The eventual decisive break — accompanied by a volume surge 2x the recent 5-minute average — signals that VWAP-benchmarked buyers (or sellers) have overwhelmed the opposition and are aggressively filling their remaining order quantity. At this moment, stop-loss orders from VWAP-fade traders trigger simultaneously, creating a self-reinforcing cascade. At 5-second resolution, we enter within one bar of the surge bar, capturing the first 20-25 NIFTY spot points of institutional-driven continuation before the move partially exhausts.
core_signal_oneliner: Decisive VWAP break (0.1%+) after 3+ intraday VWAP tests with 2x volume surge confirming supply/demand exhaustion
